description: This file implements the 'Create' feature for comments in a social/blog application, including request validation, handling the creation of a comment, associating it with an article and author, and saving it to the database.

classes.name: Create
classes.description: Contains nested record types for CommentData, Command, Model, a validator class for the command, and a handler class that processes the create comment operation.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the create comment command by validating article existence, retrieving current user, creating a new Comment, saving it, and returning the CommentEnvelope.
